content.title: Olivia Munn Reveals Her Mom Was Diagnosed With Breast Cancer After Taking Same Risk Test That 'Saved' Her Life
content.text: Olivia Munn's mom was diagnosed with breast cancer after taking the same risk assessment test that her daughter, who revealed her own breast cancer diagnosis in March 2024, credits with saving her life.Munn, who has spoken openly about her own experience with breast cancer, shared mom Kim Munn's diagnosis in an Instagram post July 9.The carousel of photos began with a shot of Olivia Munn and her mom smiling together, which she noted in the caption was from her mother's first day of chemotherapy treatment. “You may know that when I talk about my own battle with cancer I bring up the Lifetime Risk Assessment test that saved my life. I never would’ve predicted it would save my mom’s life as well,” Olivia Munn wrote in the caption, adding a red heart emoji. The post included a video of Kim Munn cooking after her surgery, as well as moments with Olivia Munn's husband, comedian John Mulaney. Another video shows her mom ringing the bell to signify the end of her chemotherapy treatment. Other sweet shots featured her mom with Méi, Olivia Munn and Mulaney's daughter, as well as a throwback shot of the mother-daughter duo. Olivia Munn's mom, Kim Munn, receiving treatment with son-in-law John Mulaney by her side.@oliviamunn via InstagramIn a lengthy statement within the post, Olivia Munn said her own breast cancer diagnosis in 2023 prompted her to encourage her mom to take the Tyrer-Cuzick risk assessment test. She explained that at the time, her mom scored a 26.2% on the risk assessment calculator. While Kim Munn's annual mammogram had just returned clear, her daughter said she "insisted" she get an MRI scan. “Shortly after that MRI, my mother was diagnosed with Stage 1 Her2 breast cancer,” Olivia Munn wrote. “She has since completed 12 rounds of chemo and will continue monthly Herceptin transfusions until this fall.” “From my mom being there after my double mastectomy to me being there for hers,” Olivia Munn continued. “From me having to find an oncologist, to my mom and I sharing one. I can tell you this: going through cancer is really hard. But there’s something about watching a loved one go through it that is even more heartbreaking.” Olivia Munn said she and Kim Munn's husband, Sam, took care of her through treatment, adding she was “wishing I could fight the fight for her, even if only for a day to give her a little break.” The actor then emphasized the impact the Tyrer-Cuzick risk assessment tool had for both her and her mother. The free test can be taken online and provides a score that represents lifetime risk of developing breast cancer.“My mom wanted me to tell you that she hopes by sharing her story it will help save someone’s life,” Olivia Munn added before thanking their health care team and signing off, “Olivia Munn and Miss Kim.” Olivia Munn's Breast Cancer Journey In April 2023, Olivia Munn was diagnosed with luminal B breast cancer after a series of genetic tests. She noted at the time that she previously tested negative for the BRCA gene commonly linked to breast cancer and that she had a clear mammogram. Within 30 days of her diagnosis, Olivia Munn underwent “a lymph node dissection, a nipple delay procedure (a surgical procedure which spares the nipples) and a double mastectomy,” People reported. Following the double mastectomy, which removes both breasts to reduce the risk of cancer returning, she underwent a breast reconstruction to make her breasts smaller than they were before. In November 2023, Olivia Munn began hormone suppression therapy to lessen the likelihood that the cancer would return, according to People. The therapy, however, put her into medically induced menopause. She then underwent surgery to remove her uterus, fallopian tubes and ovaries to stop the production of the hormones that cause her cancer. In May 2024, Olivia Munn told Vogue that she opted to freeze her eggs as she and Mulaney planned to have more children.
